item.title: The Best Blink Geofencing App in 2026 (Tested Options Compared)
item.description:
Blink does not have geofencing built in, so “the best Blink geofencing app” really means “the best way to bolt location-based arming onto Blink.” There are five realistic options in 2026, and only one of them is an actual app you install and forget. This page ranks them by how well they work for a normal household, not a lab.

Quick verdict: For most people, a dedicated app like GeoCam is the best option: about two minutes to set up, works on iOS and Android, handles a whole family on one plan (3.99 euro/month or 39.99 euro/year), and talks to Blink directly. Alexa, IFTTT, Apple Shortcuts, and Home Assistant can all be made to work, but each trades away reliability, cost, or setup time.
